notes: The cards' conformance cases (851-3198, docs/decisions/cards.md › Conformance and tolerance): each runs a card spec over the period of `range` containing `date` (a day in `timeZone`, default UTC, with weeks from `firstWeekday`, default monday), with the clock at `now`, on dataset.json (the Health tools' dataset, then the cards' batches). Every engine must give `expected`, the card's data as the tools write it.
`spec` is an input, as apps and tools write it: each engine canonicalizes it first, and it must be valid.
Outputs match as JSON, except that numbers may differ by a relative 1e-9 (sums added in another order).
Write expected outputs by hand, from the dataset and docs/decisions/cards.md, not by copying what an engine returns. `note` says how a case's values come about where it isn't obvious.
`iphone.skip` says why the iPhone's engine (851-3201), which reads HealthKit, can't match a case: it runs every other one.

cases.name: example: body temperature, a line over a month
example: sleeping heart rate, heart rate while asleep per night, from whichever source slept most
cases.note: Nights: 21 Oct is the Watch's (410 min asleep against the iPhone's 360), and its 10-minute wake isn't asleep; 22 Oct is the iPhone's (480 min against the Watch's 120), with the Watch's readings; 23 Oct is a day's sleep (a nap starting at 15:00), so no night; 24 Oct's nap after the night is another session; 25 Oct runs across the clock change. Heart rate is time-weighted: a reading counts until its source's next one in the same stretch, else the stretch's end, at most an hour. Drawn as ranges, the header is the period's lowest and highest.

cases.name: the heart rate seed card: each reading weighted until its source's next, up to an hour
cases.note: 26 Oct (GMT): the Watch's 50 at 03:00 (until 12:00, capped: 3600 s), 70 at 12:00 (until 12:20: 1200 s), 80 at 12:20 (until 28 Oct, capped: 3600 s); the strap's 90 at 12:20, its last, for its own minute (60 s). 28 Oct: the Watch's 66, its last, lasting no time: 1 s. Drawn as ranges, the header is the lowest and highest.

cases.name: heart rate on the day the clocks go back, by the hour: 01:00 comes twice
cases.note: 25 Oct in London is 25 hours. 00:30Z is 01:30 BST and 01:30Z is 01:30 GMT, two hours that start at 01:00. Weights: 50 until 48 (3600 s), 48 until 22:57 (capped: 3600 s), and 22:57's 64, whose next reading (03:00Z) is more than an hour past the period, for its own duration: 1 s.

cases.name: heart rate from 22:00 to 06:00 on the day the clocks go back: a reading counts until its next one in the stretch, or the stretch's end
cases.note: The stretches: from midnight to 06:00 GMT (7 hours, 01:00 twice) and from 22:00 GMT. 50 counts until 48 (3600 s), 48 until 06:00 (capped: 3600 s), and 64 at 22:57 until its stretch ends, past the period (capped: 3600 s), not 1 s as without a window.

cases.name: HRV from 22:00 to 06:00, crossing midnight: each reading in the day its start falls in, 06:00 itself outside
cases.note: In: 20 Oct 23:00 BST (40) and 22 Oct 01:30 BST (60). Out: 23 Oct 05:00Z, 06:00 BST, and 25 Oct 06:00Z, 06:00 GMT (the window ends at 06:00), and the readings at 07:00 BST.

cases.name: a count of weigh-ins before noon on the local clock, either side of the clock change

cases.name: a count of heart rate readings while asleep, per night: dots by default, since a count has no range
heart rate in Los Angeles on the day the clocks go forward, by the hour: 23 hours, no 02:00
cases.note: 9 Mar 2025 runs from 08:00Z to 07:00Z on 10 Mar. 01:50 PST (09:50Z) is followed by 03:05 PDT (10:05Z): the hour after 01:00 is 03:00, at 10:00Z. Weights: 00:40 until 01:50 (capped: 3600 s), 01:50 until 03:05 (900 s), 03:05 until 03:15 (600 s), 03:15 until 04:00 (2700 s), 04:00 until 07:00 and 07:00 until 22:57 (capped: 3600 s each), and 22:57's 66, whose next reading (09:30Z on 10 Mar) is more than an hour past the period, for its own duration: 1 s.

cases.name: heart rate from 01:30 to 03:30 on the day the clocks go forward: an hour long, since 02:00 to 03:00 doesn't exist
cases.note: The stretch is 01:30 PST (09:30Z) to 03:30 PDT (10:30Z). 01:50's 52 counts until 03:05 (900 s), 03:05's 51 until 03:15 (600 s) and 03:15's 63 until the stretch's end (900 s). 04:00 is outside.

cases.name: heart rate asleep and in the 5 minutes before sleep, per night, over the week the clocks go forward
cases.note: Weeks from Sunday: 9 to 15 Mar 2025. 9 Mar's night starts at 23:30 PST on the 8th, the evening before the period, and is asleep across the skipped hour, but for 03:10 to 03:20 PDT awake: its stretches are 07:30Z to 10:10Z and 10:20Z to 13:30Z. 00:40's 55 counts until 01:50 (capped: 3600 s), 01:50's 52 until 03:05 PDT (900 s), 03:05's 51 until its stretch ends at 03:10 (300 s), 04:00's 49 until its stretch's end (capped: 3600 s); 03:15's 63 is awake. 10 Mar's night (23:00 to 07:00 PDT) has 02:30's 50. Before sleep: 23:27 PST's 67 and 22:57 PDT's 66, each until sleep starts (180 s). 8 Mar's and 16 Mar's nights are outside the week. The header is the lead's.

cases.name: the first weigh-in before noon by the day over the month the clocks go forward
cases.note: 19:30Z is 11:30 PST on 8 Mar 2025, but 12:30 PDT on the 9th, so the 9th has none. 10 Mar's first is 08:00 PDT (70.3), before 11:45's 70.5. Days start at -08:00 until the 9th and at -07:00 from the 10th. The header is the average of the days' firsts.

cases.name: sleeping heart rate by the week over the month the clocks go forward, weeks from Sunday
cases.note: 8 Mar 2025's night (a Saturday) is in the week of 2 Mar; 9 and 10 Mar's (as in the week's case) in the week of 9 Mar, which starts at midnight PST, before the change; 16 Mar's in the week of 16 Mar, at midnight PDT. Each reading asleep counts until the next in its stretch or the stretch's end, at most an hour.

cases.name: heart rate in Los Angeles on the day the clocks go back, by the hour: 25 hours, 01:00 twice
cases.note: 2 Nov 2025 runs from 07:00Z to 08:00Z on 3 Nov. 01:00 PDT is 08:00Z and 01:00 PST 09:00Z. Weights: 01:30 PDT until 01:58 (1680 s), 01:58 until 01:01 PST (180 s), 01:01 until 01:30 PST (1740 s), 01:30 PST until 03:10 (capped: 3600 s), 03:10 until 04:00 (3000 s), 04:00 until 06:30 and 06:30 until 22:27 (capped: 3600 s each), and 22:27's 65, whose next reading (09:30Z on 3 Nov) is more than an hour past the period, for its own duration: 1 s.

cases.name: heart rate from 01:00 to 02:00 on the day the clocks go back: two hours of readings
cases.note: The stretch is 01:00 PDT (08:00Z) to 02:00 PST (10:00Z), both 01:00s. Each reading counts until the next (1680, 180 and 1740 s), and 01:30 PST's 54 until the stretch's end (1800 s), not an hour as without a window.

cases.name: sleeping heart rate per night over the week the clocks go back
cases.note: Weeks from Sunday: 2 to 8 Nov 2025. 2 Nov's night: in bed awake from 00:30 PDT, asleep from 01:02 PST (09:02Z) to 03:00 and from 03:20 to 06:00 PST. 01:30 PDT's 60 is awake in bed, though 01:30 PST's 54 is asleep; 03:10's 62 is awake. 54 and 04:00's 50 each count until their stretch's end (capped: 3600 s). 3 Nov's night (22:30 to 06:30 PST) has 01:30's 51. 1 Nov's and 9 Nov's nights are outside the week. Drawn as ranges, the header is the lowest and highest.

cases.name: heart rate in the 5 minutes before falling asleep, per night, over the week the clocks go back: 01:57 PDT to 01:02 PST
cases.note: 2 Nov 2025's sleep starts at 01:02 PST (09:02Z), not when the Watch's in-bed awake record starts. Its 5 minutes are elapsed time, 08:57Z to 09:02Z, across the change: 01:58 PDT's 66 counts until 01:01 PST (180 s), and 64 until sleep starts (60 s). 01:30 PDT's 60 is before them. 3 Nov's sleep starts at 22:30 PST on the 2nd: 22:27's 65 counts 180 s.

cases.name: sleeping heart rate by the week over the month the clocks go back, weeks from Sunday
cases.note: 1 Nov 2025's night (a Saturday, 23:00 to 07:00 PDT) is in the week of 26 Oct, which starts before the period: it counts, its day being in it. 2 and 3 Nov's nights (as in the week's case) are in the week of 2 Nov, which starts at midnight PDT, before the change; 9 Nov's in the week of 9 Nov, at midnight PST. Each reading counts until its stretch's end, at most an hour.

cases.name: morning weight over the week the clocks go back: the first weigh-in before noon each day, and its 7-day rolling average
cases.note: 19:30Z is 12:30 PDT on 1 Nov 2025, but 11:30 PST on the 2nd, so the 2nd's counts and the 1st has none. 3 Nov's first is 07:30 PST (70.1), before 08:00's 70.3; 5 Nov's 12:30 PST is after noon. The average reaches back before the period, to 31 Oct's 07:30 PDT (70.5): the 2nd's is 31 Oct's and the 2nd's, the 3rd's those and the 3rd's. The header is the average of the days' firsts.
